Brightport_gunfryk1.m: With us around all those Nor City thugs are shaking in their boots, Brightport has never been safer.

brightport_gunfryk.m: I'm the guard commander. Inform me or my men if you spot any trouble.
r: [Lie] My friend was chased by a lizardman and he went inside the derelict house east of town. Please save him!
I heard you really love orchids, Sir Gunfryk. [Blackmail him with the records.]
Sir, I have some information on two troublemakers in town who wish to see you gone.
Can you tell me more about your job?

brightport_gunfryk0.m: We protect Brightport from the critters of the wilderness and barbaric monsters such as those lizardmen. All by decree of our king, Lord Geomyr.

brightport_gunfryk1.m: Those Nor City agitators are a dime a dozen; however, we can only act under Feygard law. The first thing we need is evidence.

brightport_gunfryk10.m: I see, good luck with that.

brightport_gunfryk11.m: Most interesting, Nor City made? Nothing of that sort passes through our checkpoints without permission. Yes, that warrants an investigation. What are the name of these criminals?

brightport_gunfryk12.m: Well done, $playername. They will be apprehended as soon as I give my men the order. As for you, a reward is most deserving, here is some gold.

brightport_gunfryk13.m: We sure need more brave, law-upholding youngsters like you around! I'll make sure to write to my superiors about it. After graduating from the academy here, be sure to give the military academy a try. Glory to Feygard!

brightport_gunfryk14.m: That is understandable. I was a bit hopeful, we've long needed a reason to nail down the coffin of the remaining criminals in town.

brightport_gunfryk15.m: This time was a miss, but we sure need more brave youngsters like you who are not afraid to speak up. Glory to Feygard!

brightport_gunfryk16.m: You remember the deal you made with Barthold and Dynes, even though they gave you the money you still handed the evidence over to the guards.

brightport_gunfryk17.m: Most interesting, Nor City made? Nothing of that sort passes through our checkpoints without permission. Yes, that warrants an investigation. What are the name of these criminals?

brightport_gunfryk18.m: You're not sure if what you're feeling right now is guilt, or the feeling of breaking a promise.

brightport_gunfryk19.m: We sure need more brave, law-upholding youngsters like you around! I'll make sure to write to my superiors about it. After graduating from the academy here, be sure to give the military academy a try. Glory to Feygard!

brightport_gunfryk2.m: Lizardman you say? That is extremely serious. I will call my men and we will hurry to save him!

brightport_gunfryk20.m: What is certain, however, is that if there's any honor among Nor City's thieves, they'll surely have none to spare for you.

brightport_gunfryk21.m: That is understandable. I was a bit hopeful, we've long needed a reason to nail down the coffin of the remaining criminals in town.

brightport_gunfryk22.m: This time was a miss, but we sure need more brave youngsters like you who are not afraid to speak up. Glory to Feygard!

brightport_gunfryk3.m: What? [The commander gulps dryly.] Who told you that? And anyway, my favorites are orchids!
r: I also heard you love rolling in the flower fields and smelling the roses. I think the others would love hearing that too. [Wave around the records of him visiting a flower shop.]

brightport_gunfryk4.m: Grr... This is blackmail. I get it. What is it? What do you want?
r: You've put my two acquaintances, Dynes and Barthold, in a tough spot with your rules. I'd appreciate it if you gave them some leeway, unless you want others to hear about your "activities".

brightport_gunfryk5.m: Have it your way, and keep those papers away from my subordinates. If word got out, my reputation would be ruined! But don't think this will last for long...

brightport_gunfryk6.m: Reputable eyewitnesses. Records. In case of swindling or smuggling, illegal merchandise. Word of mouth means nothing.
r: I think I heard them mention a smuggling cave of sorts, that they use to evade the law.

brightport_gunfryk7.m: As if they could ever evade the watchful eyes of my men! Although...

brightport_gunfryk8.m: If you came here to tell me, there may be some truth to your words, kid. If you want to do the right thing for the glory of Feygard, then see if you can find anything I could order my men to act on. But don't stick your neck out too much, those savages will stop at nothing.
r: I'll do my best, Glory to Feygard!
Sure, but I'm doing this because I want to, not because of your silly laws.

brightport_gunfryk9.m: Any progress on that investigation of yours?
r: I found their hideout and inside was this blade.
I found a bunch of goods hidden in a cave east, here's a blade I took.
Not yet. But I'll find something substantial soon.

brightport_gunfryk_help.m: It's good to see you around, glory to Feygard.
r: Can you tell me more about your job?

brightport_gunfryk_killfail.m: Is your friend safe?! I sent my men to the derelict manor and they caught a Nor city spy, but no trace of any lizardmen or your friend!
r: Umm. Ermm. He is alright sir.

brightport_gunfryk_killfail0.m: The commander extends his arm to grab your shoulder.

brightport_gunfryk_killfail2.m: Then that is good, and if not for you we wouldn't have gone there and found that spy. You can have his cloak, well done.

brightport_gunfryk_selector_after.m: It sours my day to see a treacherous criminal rat. You and your friends will regret this one day.

brightport_thieves.10: The Thieves Guild was due to receive a package, but the guards in Brightport have been impeding their activities. They need a new face like me to pick the package up discretly. I was told to head east of the town.
brightport_thieves.20: I met the courier from Nor City inside the house.
brightport_thieves.30: Before we could conclude the meeting we heard the town guard making noise outside.
brightport_thieves.35: Thanks to some previous interactions I've had with the commander, I convinced the guards to let me go.
brightport_thieves.40: I couldn't fool the guards and got caught.
brightport_thieves.45: I managed to hide inside a crate and waited. Eventually, the guards left.
brightport_thieves.50: I delivered the package to Elysa, She was pleased with my work and said the Thieves Guild may have further opportunities for me in the future.
brightport_thieves.60: I lied to Gunfryk in a plot to kill him, and in the process the courier I was supposed to meet got arrested.
brightport_thieves.70: I failed to deliver the package to Elysa. She was not happy.

brightport_goons.10: Inside a house in Brightport, I met two people named Dynes and Barthold. It turned out that they are the friends Benbyr told me to visit. Rather lacking in hospitality, they offered me work.
brightport_goons.20: Barthold was hesitant because any job I could do for them would put me at odds with Gunfryk the guard commander. Taking that into account I offered to rid them of him.
brightport_goons.30: I was told not to kill him, but surely it won't be a problem if I do. Either way I'll resolve things for them.
brightport_goons.40: I received some records from silvear that could be useful as blackmail against Gunfryk.
brightport_goons.60: I used the records to blackmail Gunfryk. To save his reputation he begrudgingly agreed to give Barthold and Dynes some leeway.
brightport_goons.50: I lied to the commander that there are some lizardmen in the derelict house east of town, I should go there and prepare an ambush.
brightport_goons.70: I ambushed and killed Gunfryk in the house to the east, along with the two guards he brought.
brightport_goons.80: I informed the commander about Barthold and Dynes' scheme. He requested that I find some incriminating evidence of their role.
brightport_goons.110: I found some of the duo's merchandise in the smuggling cave east of brightport.
brightport_goons.130: I opted to blackmail the duo instead for some quick gold. Should've had the Guild's protection, suckers!
brightport_goons.135: I told the commander I couldn't find anything
brightport_goons.136: Barthold was disappointed in me for having done nothing about Gunfryk. Little did he know I lined my pockets with his merchandise.
brightport_goons.90: Barthold was happy with my work and gave me a reward, he said I could find more work like this in Nor City.
brightport_goons.100: Barthold was a little disappointed about me killing Gunfryk. It's possible that now Feygard might take more severe action with Brightport.
brightport_goons.120: Gunfryk was happy with my work, the duo will soon be jailed. He said Feygard needs more brave youngsters like me and that I should give the military academy a try.
brightport_goons.119: I gave the commander the blade, even though I already got paid not to. If there's any honor among Nor City's thieves, they will surely have none to spare for me.
brightport_goons.140: I told the commander I couldn't find anything, even though I had the blade I blackmailed Barthold and Dynes with.
